description: KNa₃WO₅ crystallizes in the monoclinic C2/m space group. K is bonded in a distorted body-centered cubic geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of K-O bond distances ranging from 2.89-3.01 Å. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to five O atoms to form distorted NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids that share  a cornercorner with one WO₅ trigonal bipyramid, corners with five NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids, edges with two equivalent WO₅ trigonal bipyramids, and edges with four NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.30-2.40 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to five O atoms to form NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with two equivalent NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids, corners with five equivalent WO₅ trigonal bipyramids, and edges with four equivalent NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.32-2.69 Å. W is bonded to five O atoms to form WO₅ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with seven NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids and edges with four equivalent NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids. There are a spread of W-O bond distances ranging from 1.86-1.94 Å. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to four equivalent K, one Na, and one W atom to form distorted OK₄NaW octahedra that share corners with twelve OK₂Na₃W octahedra, corners with four equivalent ONa₄W trigonal bipyramids, edges with four equivalent OK₄NaW octahedra, and faces with four OK₂Na₃W octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 12-67°. In the second O site, O is bonded to four Na and one W atom to form ONa₄W trigonal bipyramids that share corners with four OK₂Na₃W octahedra, corners with four equivalent ONa₄W trigonal bipyramids, edges with four OK₂Na₃W octahedra, and edges with two equivalent ONa₄W trigonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 54-63°. In the third O site, O is bonded to two equivalent K, three Na, and one W atom to form distorted OK₂Na₃W octahedra that share corners with eight OK₂Na₃W octahedra, corners with two equivalent ONa₄W trigonal bipyramids, edges with three OK₂Na₃W octahedra, edges with four equivalent ONa₄W trigonal bipyramids, and faces with two equivalent OK₄NaW octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 2-67°. In the fourth O site, O is bonded to two equivalent K, three Na, and one W atom to form distorted OK₂Na₃W octahedra that share corners with eight OK₄NaW octahedra, corners with two equivalent ONa₄W trigonal bipyramids, edges with three OK₂Na₃W octahedra, edges with four equivalent ONa₄W trigonal bipyramids, and faces with two equivalent OK₄NaW octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 2-66°.
